observations.body: Treasure in clay jars carries death and life. But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves. For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
